card.text: Explore Diomedes in 3D with its published shape model and radial elevation.

introduction.text: Jupiter Trojan in the L4 leading cloud. Convex light-curve reconstruction. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: Diomedes · DAMIT 4215 convex shape
shape.summary: Convex light-curve model fitted to a stellar occultation: 118.8 ± 0.6 km volume-equivalent diameter. Grid marks unavailable imagery; rotational phase is illustrative.

elevation.title: Diomedes · source-model radial height
elevation.summary: Radius on the shape model minus a 59.4 km reference sphere, in false color. Heights inherit the size uncertainty; this is not independent topography or gravitational height.
